sessions.title: SDOL-011 Prompt Injection Mitigation — Feature #737
sessions.summary: Completed prompt injection mitigation for NL-to-SPARQL pipeline (issue #737, sub-issues #778–#780). XML fencing added to prompts in NlToSparqlService; validate_operation() added to sparql_validator.py rejecting non-SELECT/ASK SPARQL at all 3 generation sites. Two test files updated/created with 10 total tests. Code reviews caught and fixed double regex call and retry-path silent break. Two open spec findings: possible WARNING log gap on allowlist fallback, stale spec wording on 'both retry prompts'. Branch hierarchy: feature/737 squashes into feature/782 squashes into feature/781-sdol-011.
accomplishments: Issue #784 moved to In Progress with PSR labels
blockers: 2 open spec findings on prompt injection safeguards
Matt Pocock TDD workflow violation (tests written without red-green loop)

sessions.title: SDOL-011 Issues #737 & #738 Closed — Feature #782
sessions.summary: Closed issues #737 (prompt injection) and #738 (CSP header) with squash commits into feature/782-threat-modeling. Prompt injection work completed: XML fencing, validate_operation() allowlist, PromptInjectionError exception class, wired at 3 LLM generation sites. Code review caught missing PromptInjectionError guard in convert_with_retry() first-gen block. CSP implementation: FastAPI security_headers middleware, style-src 'unsafe-inline' for React inline styles, connect-src https://*.hana.ondemand.com wildcard. CF staticfile_buildpack nginx header injection via location_include pattern (not bare nginx.conf). Both issues closed on WDF GitHub with status comments.
accomplishments: PromptInjectionError guards both convert() and convert_with_retry()
CSP header deployed to FastAPI + CF nginx

sessions.title: SDOL-011 Host Endpoint SSRF Sub-Issues — Feature #782 Wrap
sessions.summary: Wrapped session on issue #735 (host_endpoint SSRF protection) and completed sub-issue #788 (ingestion validator). Corrected #735 spec: RFC-1918/loopback/link-local IP blocklist, not HTTP scheme validation — host_endpoint is a TCP socket address, not HTTP client input. All connectors use bare hostnames; HANA strips https:// prefixes. DNS rebinding identified as attack vector. Sub-issue #788 implemented with Pydantic validators on ConnectionBase/ConnectionUpdate/TestConnectionRequest. Security review found IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypass (::ffff:10.x.x.x) and missing 0.0.0.0/8 — both fixed. 70 tests passing; squashed onto feature/782-threat-modeling. Sub-issues #789 (runtime DNS guard) and #790 (Dremio JDBC scheme) established as backlog. Issue #734 deferred for Beta. Concept notes created for #788/#789/#790; board updated; journal appended; 30 entities added to backlink queue.
accomplishments: 70 tests passing after all review fixes
Session wrapped: 4 files written (notes + board + journal + queue)
blockers: #789 runtime DNS guard (concurrent.futures + getaddrinfo) in progress
